{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rodian Swamp Lizard''' was a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Alric Adannon]] wore a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] made from the hide of a Rodian Swamp Lizard, although he claimed it was made from the hide of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
